name: Sayyid Ahmad Barelvi
contribution: He led a reformist and militant movement that influenced Islamic reform currents across North India and Bengal.
context: His Tariqah-i-Muhammadiya network became a major reference for nineteenth-century Muslim revivalism and resistance.
impact: His movement is important background for Titumir and related Bengal reformist networks.
highlight: A key reformist influence behind Bengal-linked Tariqah-i-Muhammadiya currents.
